_what: SEL-RANK Deliverable 1: descriptive attribution on P2's own full-navtest 64-proposal table. MEASURED (descriptive), T1 NAVSIM v1.1. Nothing fitted.

estimator.name: paired log-cluster bootstrap (zero_tail.Boot)
estimator.answers: another draw of LOGS only; NOT another training run (H-ESTIM-SEED-1: P2 is ONE seed); NOT another inference run (deterministic argmax)

A_attribution.method: Shapley over the three multiplicative factors (NC, DAC, W) of the move pick -> oracle proposal (6 orderings), W split over EP/TTC/C by its own linear weights 5/5/2 over 12; averaged over proposals tied at the oracle PDMS. EXACT: the five terms sum to oracle - pick token by token.
A_attribution.formula_source: NAVSIM v1 PDMS = NC*DAC*(5EP+5TTC+2C)/12, DDC at weight 0: repo-cited navsim @ 3e8291b pdm_scorer.py:38-42 (refe/planner.py:520 and :558-561; refe/scorer_finetune.py:85-87; eval/rule_mismatch_diag.py:7). The vendored NAVSIM source is NOT on this box, so the file:line is INHERITED by citation; the formula itself is MEASURED here: it reproduces the table's pdms on all 12,146 x 64 entries with max |diff| in G.

decisive_pair_error_budget_pool_S.note: pool S tokens only; units = aggregate points x100 averaged over ALL 12,146 tokens (same denominator as the 5.88); predicted terms are Shapley terms of NC_hat*DAC_hat*(5EP_hat+5TTC_hat+2C_hat)/12 on the move pick->oracle, realised terms are the section-A terms. CAUTION: the predicted terms are conditioned on the pick being the scorer's ARGMAX (winner's curse: any noisy scorer over-states its own pick), so 'error' and its share are NOT a head ranking; only frac_pool_tokens_head_inverts_pair is quoted, and the counterfactual section D is the head ranking.

top8_pairwise_concordance_per_head.note: AUC-like: P(head scores the better proposal higher) over ordered pairs INSIDE the scorer's own top-8 by sel_score whose realised values differ (EP: by more than 0.05); 0.5 = chance, ties count half.

D_oracle_head_bounds.definition: at selection, replace the named head(s)' PREDICTED probability by its REALISED sub-score (same token, same 64 proposals), keep every other head as the scorer predicted it, apply the planner's own rule NC*DAC*(5EP+5TTC+2C)/12 and take the argmax (first index on a tie, as torch.argmax in the planner). Gain = mean PDMS at that pick minus mean PDMS at P2's pick. An UPPER bound for 'a perfect <head>', not an estimate of any trainable arm.

identity_pick_equals_table_pick.note: float64 numpy recompute vs the table's float32 torch pick

reach_vs_head_quality_blend.definition: p_head' = (1 - lam) * P2's predicted probability + lam * the realised sub-score; PDMS at argmax of the planner's rule. lam is an explicit, ASSUMED model of 'how far a retrained head moves toward the truth'; it is not an estimate of any arm.
